title: 第5章 扔到洞里第6章 群蛇包围
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
听到这句话的江凌寒，瞬间觉得自己的等待被辜负了，抬手就将那枚玉佩狠狠地丢了过去。
“你的东西找到了，还给你！”
可力道一时没收住，玉佩便直直砸在了地上，一声脆响后，碎成了两半。
苏虞的脸色瞬间比他的还要冷上几分。
这家伙有病吧？
突然出现不说，还把她的东西弄坏了。
早知道，就不将他的东西全须全尾地送回去了！
至少卖掉都可以换灵石呢！
可她不知道，那鞭子早在送回去那一刻，就成了废品。
苏虞将玉佩捡了起来，表情不变。
只是心脏无端传来闷闷的刺痛，疼得让人有些喘不过气。
以前自己满心欢喜地将它送出去的时候，恐怕也没想过它会被这样还回来吧？
她抬眼，漂亮的杏眼裹着细碎的怒火，“既然如此，你我往后就算是两不相欠了！”
哪怕江凌寒在心里猜测过她会有的反应，却还是在听到这句话时，心头一紧。
谁也没看到他藏在衣袖下的手指在微微颤抖。
——他又不是故意的，谁叫她没接住！
两不相欠就两不相欠，谁稀罕！
然而在他离开时，江凌寒却忽然看到她在桌上摆着的东西，顿住了脚步。
这瓷瓶，不正是沈落雪以前救他时，拿出来的那个吗？
怎么会在她这里？

少年的眉眼瞬间覆上了寒霜，桀骜的身姿带着满满的压迫感。
他指着药瓶厉声质问：“这明明是落雪师姐的东西，你竟敢偷师姐的丹药！”
闻言，苏虞循着他的目光看去，望着那药瓶只觉得茫然。
随后她皱了皱眉，努力回想那空白的记忆，最终只能放弃，靠自己来判断。
沈落雪又不喜欢她，怎么可能给她送东西？
而且自己也不可能在收下后，还摆在如此明显的地方。
所以苏虞只当是自己随手搁置的物件，刚想反驳。
“我没偷，这是我的……”
可那安静的几秒，却被江凌寒认定成了心虚。
“别狡辩了！你又不是没有对我撒过谎！”
——既然不信，那你问个屁！
苏虞立刻住了嘴，忍住要骂人的冲动。
而江凌寒盛怒之下，竟上前一步，死死抓住了少女的手腕，力道大得几乎要捏碎她的骨头。
content_en:
When Jiang Linghan heard these words, he immediately felt that his waiting had been let down. He raised his hand and threw the jade pendant away.
"I found your stuff and I'll give it back to you!"
But the force failed to restrain it for a moment, and the jade pendant hit the ground, with a crisp sound, and broke into two halves.
Su Yu's face instantly turned colder than his.
Is this guy sick?
He showed up suddenly and broke her things.
If I had known earlier, I wouldn't have sent all his things back!
At least you can exchange it for spiritual stones if you sell it!
But she didn't know that the whip had become useless the moment it was sent back.
Su Yu picked up the jade pendant, his expression unchanged.
It's just that there is a dull stinging pain in the heart for no reason, and the pain is so painful that it makes people breathless.
When I gave it away happily before, I probably never thought that it would be returned like this, right?
She raised her eyes, her beautiful almond eyes covered with tiny anger, "In this case, you and I will owe nothing to each other from now on!"
Even though Jiang Linghan had guessed her reaction in his heart, his heart tightened when he heard these words.
No one saw that his fingers hidden under his sleeves were trembling slightly.
——He didn’t mean it, why didn’t she catch it!
If the two don't owe each other, then the two don't owe each other. Who cares!
However, when he left, Jiang Linghan suddenly saw what she put on the table and stopped.
Isn't this porcelain bottle the one Shen Luoxue took out when she rescued him before?
Why is she here?
The young man's eyebrows were instantly covered with frost, and his unruly figure was filled with a sense of oppression.
He pointed at the medicine bottle and asked sternly: "This is clearly the property of Senior Sister Luoxue, how dare you steal Senior Sister's elixir!"
Hearing this, Su Yu followed his gaze and felt confused when looking at the medicine bottle.
Then she frowned and tried to recall the blank memory. In the end, she could only give up and judge by herself.
Shen Luoxue didn't like her, so how could she give her something?
And it was impossible for him to keep it in such an obvious place after accepting it.
So Su Yu just regarded it as an object he put aside casually, and was about to refute.
"I didn't steal it, this is mine..."
But those few quiet seconds were regarded by Jiang Linghan as a sign of guilty conscience.
"Stop quibbling! It's not like you haven't lied to me before!"
——If you don’t believe it, then why don’t you ask!
Su Yu immediately stopped talking and resisted the urge to curse.
In his rage, Jiang Linghan stepped forward and grabbed the girl's wrist with such force that he almost crushed her bones.
